title: Paul Before King Agrippa
description: Paul defends himself before King Agrippa and tells of his conversion on the road to Damascus. Festus cries out that Paul is mad, but Agrippa replies: "With so little you will persuade me to become a Christian!" The king states that Paul could have been set free if he had not appealed to Caesar.
